last_scene.summary: Arlequino said 'Давайте что то. .... По мрачнее что ли....' and performed 'Тьмы Князь', using the user-supplied adapted lyrics and presenting it as a dark, highly theatrical mini-play. Audience response was not inferred only from lyrical darkness: a directly recoverable real listener comment on the original song calls it 'эпичен)', and this was used as the core reaction model. Some spectators were drawn into the theatrical ruler/monster persona, some reacted most strongly to the recurring declaration of the dark prince and the hell/temptation imagery, while others remained more amused or wary than frightened. No Earth-specific names or historical references were introduced to NPC knowledge. Tips +14s72c, expenses 0, net +14s72c.
